incidents.name: BEGO mint signature verification bypass
incidents.notes: BEGO's mint() recovered the signer from attacker-supplied v/r/s and never checked it against an authorised signer, so anyone could mint BEGO and sell it into the pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: BEGO 0xc342774492b54ce5F8ac662113ED702Fc1b34972 created 2021-03-10T13:53:56Z by 0x56de05b6a7cdf80feee17ad3bdf80ad72603b666, unrelated to attack sender 0xde01f6ce91e4f4bdb94bb934d30647d72182320f; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 12.03 WBNB left the BEGO pair to the attacker; 12.03 WBNB x $273.28 at incidentTimestamp 1666197275 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $3,288.
